messages.content: 请帮我检索一下'红星科技'公司目前所有未解决的工单，我想要查看最多10个。

function.name: get_tickets
function.description: Retrieve a list of tickets for a specified customer based on the company name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

customer.description: The name of the company for which to retrieve tickets.

status.description: The status of the tickets to be retrieved.

limit.description: The maximum number of tickets to retrieve.

message.content: 您提到想查看“红星科技”公司的所有未解决工单，能否确认一下您是想获取状态为 **open**（开放）还是 **pending**（待处理）的工单？如果两者都需要，请告诉我。

The function get_tickets expects status values: "open" | "closed" | "pending" | "resolved". There's no "unresolved" but we can interpret unresolved as not resolved, maybe "open" or "pending"? The user says "目前所有未解决的工单" meaning all current unresolved tickets. That could be "open" or "pending". We need to decide which status to use. Possibly "open" includes pending? But the function only has "open", "closed", "pending", "resolved". So unresolved might be "open" or "pending". The user didn't specify status, but they want unresolved. We can ask clarifying question: do they want both open and pending? Or just open? The user said "未解决" which could include pending. I'd ask clarifying question.
